key_insight: SparseModesNet reconstructs coupled thermo-hydro-mechanical fields more accurately than linear POD at the same reduced dimension by selecting modes for reconstruction quality and using a nonlinear neural decoder.
engineering_relevance: Compact representations of displacement, pressure, and temperature could support efficient analysis of heterogeneous and fractured geothermal systems.
method: Start with a larger pool of candidate modes.
Select a small mode set to reduce reconstruction error rather than retain only the highest-energy modes.
Use a neural-network nonlinear decoder to reconstruct coupled solution fields.
evidence_signal: Evaluation covers a 2D heterogeneous medium, a 2D connected fracture network, and a 3D Utah FORGE-based geometry, including field errors, geothermal quantities of interest, and temporal interpolation of omitted snapshots.
watch_item: Temporal testing addresses interpolation within the training time interval; extrapolation and generalization to unseen geological configurations are not established by the abstract.
paper_title: SparseModesNet for coupled thermal-hydraulic-mechanical system in heterogeneous porous media
